items.title: U-admissible blowups separate disjoint closed subschemes and disjoint constructible sets
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-pushouts.tex (Pushouts of Algebraic Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-pushouts.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: (1) Z_i of finite presentation have finitely generated ideal sheaves; form Z cut by I_1 I_2 so Z ∩ U = (Z_1 ∩ U) amalga (Z_2 ∩ U), apply the Divisors-on-Spaces separation lemma to get a U ∩ Z-admissible blowup Z' -> Z with disjoint strict transforms; its center Y -> X is a finite-presentation closed immersion, so blowing up Y in X is U-admissible, and strict transforms agree under the composite blowup by the strict-transform compatibility lemma. (2) cut the constructible T_i by finite-type ideals on U (limits lemma), extend the ideals to X (extend lemma), apply (1).
